## 🚀 What is VANILLA FPS?
VANILLA FPS is a lightweight, performance-focused modpack designed specifically to bring massive frame-rate boosts and smooth gameplay to low- and mid-range hardware. Built on the Fabric/NeoForge loader, this pack strips away the engine bloat of modern Minecraft while preserving the exact core mechanics, multiplayer compatibility, and look of the original game.

### SMOOTH PVP GAMEPLAY

![NO LAG ON PVP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d22e8d12a4386a6052362dd973aaf9fde2c0294d.png)

Whether you are struggling to maintain a stable 60 FPS or looking to push your high-refresh-rate monitor to its absolute limits, VANILLA FPS optimizes game logic, rendering, and memory usage to deliver a stutter-free experience.

### ✨ Key Features & Enhancements
Massive Performance Boosts: Integrates cutting-edge optimization mods that completely overhaul Minecraft's rendering engine, chunk loading, and memory management.

**Stutter & Lag Spike Reduction:** Optimized garbage collection and engine tweaks drastically minimize frame drops and micro-stutters during world exploration.

**Out-of-the-Box Optimization:** Zero configuration required. Install the pack, launch the game, and experience instant performance improvements.

**Vanilla Compatibility:** Fully compatible with vanilla servers, realms, and standard multiplayer networks. Your favorite features remain untouched.

**Clean & Lightweight:** No intrusive content mods, custom dimensions, or heavy features that bog down your system.

## ❓ Why Choose VANILLA FPS?
Many performance packs introduce heavy visual overhauls or game-altering features that stray too far from the original game. VANILLA FPS focuses purely on what matters: uncompromised speed and stability.

If you want the absolute highest frames-per-second possible without changing how Minecraft looks and plays, this pack is built for you. It turns unplayable lag into a butter-smooth survival experience, making it the perfect base for your everyday survival worlds or competitive multiplayer sessions.
